articles.title: GTA 6 sales hit $3.8bn in a single day - the biggest entertainment launch in history
articles.description: The mammoth figure surpasses every video game launch and single-day film box office record.
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) saw record retail sales in its first full-day of release , hitting $3.8bn (£2.9bn), making it the biggest entertainment launch in history.
key_points: Take-Two, the parent company of Rockstar Games, said on Friday the figures were based on estimates through end of day on Thursday and marked a record for "entertainment across any medium".
To compare, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, this year's highest-grossing film so far, made $2.5bn (£1.8bn) over its entire run in cinemas .
Internet infrastructure firm Cloudflare said earlier that PS5 downloads in the UK peaked at 8.6 times normal levels around its launch.

articles.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
articles.description: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.
articles.summary: Anthropic's shares have dropped back towards their initial price after a soaring first day on the stock market, as a wider tech sell-off dragged markets down.
key_points: The sell-off comes as concerns remain over the speed and size of artificial intelligence investment, but also as some large companies including Nvidia and SpaceX faced specific issues that worried investors.
Those pressures combined to weigh on US markets through Friday, with all key US indexes closing sharply down on the day, furthering earlier falls over the week.
The S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average were pushed into correction territory, a point where they are trading at 10% or more down from a recent high.

articles.description: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.
articles.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, Prime Minister Andy Burnham and European Council President Antonio Costa join hands at the end of a press conference during the EU-UK summit in Brussels Andy Burnham said the UK will discuss possible options for even closer ties with the EU, after agreeing…

articles.description: The trade deal is unlikely lower food prices for shoppers, but should boost the economy more than other post-Brexit agreements.
articles.summary: The prime minister made a lot of the UK's new deal with the EU cutting costs for business and consumers during tough times.
key_points: In another world, Andy Burnham would have loved for the nation's supermarkets to clearly announce that they could cut food prices as a result of this latest agreement on food exports.
And while grocers have very much welcomed Friday's announcement, they have notably not committed to price cuts as a direct result of this move.
The managing director of M&S, Alex Freudmann, called the deal a "major step forward", saying it would remove bureaucracy.

articles.description: People stocking up on long-life food drove retail sales higher October, according to official data.
articles.summary: Retail sales rose in October, driven by people buying long-life food such as tinned goods and UHT milk, according to official figures.
key_points: Sales volumes were 0.7% higher as people responded to the government's emergency preparedness "Be Ready" campaign, the Office for National Statistics (ONS) said.
The campaign encouraged people to stock up in case of disruption to essential services by severe weather or cyberattacks.
Separate research released last week suggested that while households were stockpiling essentials, they were not panic buying .
